tweets.text:
YUMA, Ariz. — ICE & CBP thwarted an attempted smuggling incident with an unaccompanied alien child April 29.

📌U.S. Border Patrol apprehended a woman attempting to smuggle a 5-year-old boy into the United States.

📌 The United States worked with the Mexican consulate to find the child’s mother — a 24-year-old Mexican who showed up at the San Luis Port of Entry later that night to recover her child.

📌During an interview with ICE special agents, the boy’s mother revealed that she paid another woman to smuggle her child into the United States.

📌The mother said that she planned to illegally enter the U.S. April 30 to join her husband, the child’s father & an illegal alien with a prior history of illegally entering the United States.

📰Learn more about this case: https://t.co/MA38oK1Co8

tweets.text:
NOGALES, Ariz. —  We removed this 31-year-old Mexican fugitive and handed her over to Mexican authorities. She was wanted in her home country for domestic violence.

“The return of this fugitive to Mexico is a prime example of how ICE works closely with our international law enforcement partners to identify, locate and remove criminal aliens who are wanted in their native countries,” said ICE Phoenix Field Office Director John Cantu. "This fugitive attempted to flee justice in Mexico and take refuge in Arizona, which is a direct threat to our communities across Arizona."

📰Learn the details of this case and more in our newsroom.

📢 If you have information about a foreign fugitive in the U.S. illegally, call the ICE tip line at 866-347-2423.
